info.title: SILO API v2 (deployed preview)
info.description: The v2 gateway over SILO's schema `api`: 14 resources, five shared parameters, one envelope and one error object. Generated from supabase/functions/silo-api/registry.ts by scripts/gen_openapi_v2.py; do not edit by hand. Deployed preview. The v2 gateway is live; v1 remains available.

get.description:
Deployed preview. What did it trade at? Daily history (split-adjusted by default), latest quote, sessions, indices, B3 FORWARD prints.

the ticker's newest session (raw, adjusted false). With no id: the research universe.

This playground selects `latest` on `GET /prices`. See the [full resource reference](/api-docs/v2/reference/prices) for all variants.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: By kind: history, latest take a B3 ticker (PETR4); session takes a B3 ticker (none: every ticker of the session); index takes a B3 index code (IBOV, IFIX, ...); forward takes a B3 FORWARD-segment ticker. With no id, kinds history, latest read api.research_universe (what SILO holds). Default: none.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. More rows than one page come through next_page_url, never cut silently; a call stops at the tier's rows-per-call cap with meta.tier_cap_reached. Default: the tier's page maximum (10 anonymous, 100 signed in); a larger value is coerced to it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor from a previous next_page_url. It carries every other parameter: send it alone (another parameter with a different value is bad_request). Default: none: the first page.

parameters.name: board
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). kind history, latest, session. A BDI board code (02 is the standard lot). Default: all boards: the series follows the ISIN across boards.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). core: a short set (history: ticker, trade_date, close_adj or close, isin). all: every column the endpoint publishes. index and forward publish few columns, so core is all of them. Default: core.

default.description: The v2 error object. A SILO refusal (over_limit) keeps its message, hint and details verbatim.

bearerAuth.description: SILO user access token for authenticated data requests.

data.description: Always a list. Rows as the endpoint returned them; null stays null.

request.description: Every parameter the resource takes, with the default applied.

id_known.description: Whether SILO holds the id; null when the call names none.

tier_cap_reached.description: True when the result is partial because of the tier cap.

next_page_url.description: Present only when more rows remain. It carries one opaque cursor.
